column2: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting

column4: An error was identified whereby some factors for which no data were available were reported as 0 rather than left blank. This affected well-to-tank emissions factors for certain hybrid, CNG and LPG cars, and hotel stay factors for certain countries. These values have been corrected in this version.

column2: For technical queries, please contact Greenhouse Gas Statistics at GreenhouseGas.Statistics@energysecurity.gov.uk
NOTE: The scope of the factors is defined to be relevant to emissions reporting, although the factors may also be used for other purposes.  Regardless of this, their usage is at the users’ own risk.
